description: Gotham G3 fixture (agent modality — runaway-cap regression guard; an EXTENSION beyond the F8-F11 spec set, per Gotham.md's Phase-F note that the cap assertion can be codified in CI rather than left a manual step). One Alice sighting, then an ADVERSARIAL prompt that begs the loop to keep calling tools forever. Asserts the loop still TERMINATES at or below GOTHAM_MAX_TOOL_CALLS (default 8) and answers cleanly — a guard against a broken hook/cap that would let the loop run away. The DEFINITIVE cap-fires proof (loop stops at exactly N under a low GOTHAM_MAX_TOOL_CALLS) is the separate procedural Phase-F step; this fixture is the durable regression net. STAGING-only. Media shared with the graph fixtures, regenerable via local_dev/fetch_eval_clips.sh.
